report:
Scanner thoraco-abdomino-pelvien et cérébral
du 14/09/2021


INDICATION : Suivi cancer bronchique traité par chimio-immunothérapie puis lobectomie moyenne élargie au segment antérieur du LSD.

TECHNIQUE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale après injection de contraste iodé au temps portal thoraco-abdomino-pelvien et tardif cérébral.
PDC :
DLP crâne = 913mGy.cm DLP TAP = 1789mGy.cm

RESULTAT : 
Baseline  : 14/06/2021
N-1 : 13/02/2021
Lésions cibles :
Témoignage de lobectomie moyenne extrapleurale élargie au segment S3 emportant la cible 1 (vs 73 mm (n-1) vs 120 mm sur Baseline)
Remaniements fibrorétractiles aspécifiques avec travées de condensations parenchymateuses et discrets épaississements des septas prédominant dans le segment postérieur du LSD.
Discrète lame d'épanchement scissurale et pleurale droite aspécifique dans le contexte.

Lésions non cibles :
Poursuite de la régression des adénomégalies en secteur 3A, 4 R, 2R et 7 toutes infracentimétriques de petites axe.

Lésion indéterminée :
Stabilité de l'épaississement pseudonodulaire de la glande surrénale gauche de 8 mm sans hypermétabolisme significatif.

Autres constatations :
Thorax :
Occlusion partielle du stent de l'artère sous-clavière gauche avec bonne perméabilité en aval.
Statut post-thyroïdectomie totale.
Hernie hiatale par glissement stable.
Pas de micronodulation suspecte. 
Pas d'embolie pulmonaire proximale.
Emphysème centro-lobulaire diffus.

Abdomen-pelvis :
Statut post-cholécystectomie. Surrénale droite fine.
Pas de lésion suspecte hépatique. Stase stercorale pancolique. Diverticulose sigmoïdienne non compliquée.
Respect des organes pleins explorés.
Pas d'adénomégalie profonde
Stase stercorale pancolique.
Status post-traitement chirurgical du faux anévrysme fémoral commune droit.

Encéphale :
Intégrité intra extra-axiale.
Leucopathie micro angiopathique significative.
Sinus veineux endocrânien perméable.
Pas d'hydrocéphalie

Os : Pas de lésion osseuse suspecte.

CONCLUSION : 
Somme de la lésion cible : 0 mm versus 120 mm (B)
Pas de lésion non cible. Pas de nouvelle lésion.
Réponse complète selon les critères RECIST 1.1
translation:
Thoraco-abdominal-pelvic and cerebral CT scan  
Date: 09/14/2021  

INDICATION: Follow-up of bronchial cancer treated with chemo-immunotherapy followed by an extended middle lobectomy including the anterior segment of the right upper lobe.  

TECHNIQUE: Helical acquisition after iodinated contrast injection during the portal phase for the thoraco-abdominal-pelvic region and delayed phase for the brain.  
Radiation Dose:  
Cranial DLP = 913 mGy.cm  
Thoraco-abdominal-pelvic DLP = 1789 mGy.cm  

RESULTS:  
Baseline: 06/14/2021  
Previous: 02/13/2021  

Target Lesions:  
Evidence of an extrapleural middle lobectomy extended to segment S3, removing target 1 (compared to 73 mm on previous scan and 120 mm on baseline).  
Non-specific fibrotic retraction changes with parenchymal consolidation strands and mild septal thickening, predominantly in the posterior segment of the right upper lobe.  
Slight non-specific fissural and right pleural effusion in the context.  

Non-target Lesions:  
Continued regression of lymphadenopathy in regions 3A, 4R, 2R, and 7, all subcentimeter in short axis.  

Indeterminate Lesion:  
Stability of the pseudonodular thickening of the left adrenal gland at 8 mm without significant hypermetabolism.  

Other Findings:  
Thorax:  
Partial occlusion of the left subclavian artery stent with good downstream patency.  
Status post-total thyroidectomy.  
Stable sliding hiatal hernia.  
No suspicious micronodules.  
No proximal pulmonary embolism.  
Diffuse centrilobular emphysema.  

Abdomen-pelvis:  
Status post-cholecystectomy. Thin right adrenal gland.  
No suspicious hepatic lesions. Pancolonic fecal stasis. Uncomplicated sigmoid diverticulosis.  
Preservation of explored solid organs.  
No deep lymphadenopathy.  
Pancolonic fecal stasis.  
Status post-surgical treatment of the right common femoral pseudoaneurysm.  

Brain:  
Intact intra and extra-axial structures.  
Significant microangiopathic leukoencephalopathy.  
Patent intracranial venous sinuses.  
No hydrocephalus.  

Bones:  
No suspicious bone lesions.  

CONCLUSION:  
Sum of target lesion: 0 mm versus 120 mm (Baseline)  
No non-target lesions. No new lesions.  
Complete response according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.

report:
Artériographie cérébrale
du 14/08/2020


INDICATION :
 
Bilan d’un hématome lobaire sans cause retrouvée.

TECHNIQUE :
 
Asepsie du poignet droit et des scarpas au CHLORAPREP et anesthésie locale à la Xylocaïne/bicarbonate.
Ponction échoguidée de l'artère radiale droite et mise en place d'un introducteur à valve 5F.
Injection de 1 mg d’ISOPTINE avec 1 mg de RISORDAN et 2500 UI d’héparine avec surveillance scopée..
Cathétérisme sélectif des TSA à l'aide d'une sonde Simmons 2 Glide 5F + poche à pression + valve en Y. 
Pas de complication per-procédure.
Fermeture artérielle par bracelet compressif à dégonfler progressivement en 4h. Il est précisé au patient qu'il ne doit pas réaliser de sollicitation importante de ce bras pendant 24 h.

Produit de contraste :
 
[]

RESULTAT : 

Absence d'anévrisme, de malformation artérioveineuse ou de fistule durale mise en évidence sur les séries angiographiques (carotide interne droite, carotide externe droite, artère vertébrale droite, carotide commune gauche).
Par ailleurs calibre régulier et perméabilité normale des artères intracrâniennes.
Pas d'anomalie notable du drainage veineux cérébral.


CONCLUSION : 

Pas d’anomalie vasculaire.
Selon le protocole de service, nous discuterons de la prise en charge en réunion de concertation pluri-disciplinaire.
translation:
Cerebral Arteriography
08/14/2020

INDICATION:

Evaluation of a lobar hematoma with no identified cause.

TECHNIQUE:

Asepsis of the right wrist and groin with CHLORAPREP and local anesthesia with Xylocaine/bicarbonate. Ultrasound-guided puncture of the right radial artery and placement of a 5F valve introducer. Injection of 1 mg of ISOPTINE with 1 mg of RISORDAN and 2500 IU of heparin with monitored surveillance. Selective catheterization of the cervical arteries using a Simmons 2 Glide 5F catheter + pressure bag + Y-valve. No complications during the procedure. Arterial closure with a compression bracelet to be gradually deflated over 4 hours. The patient is advised not to exert significant use of this arm for 24 hours.

Contrast Agent:

[]

RESULT:

No aneurysm, arteriovenous malformation, or dural fistula detected on the angiographic series (right internal carotid, right external carotid, right vertebral artery, left common carotid). Additionally, the intracranial arteries show regular caliber and normal patency. No notable abnormalities in cerebral venous drainage.

CONCLUSION:

No vascular abnormalities. According to departmental protocol, we will discuss management in a multidisciplinary team meeting.

Asepsie du poignet droit et des scarpas au CHLORAPREP et anesthésie locale à la Xylocaïne/bicarbonate. Ponction échoguidée de l'artère radiale droite et mise en place d'un introducteur à valve 5F. Injection de 1 mg d’ISOPTINE avec 1 mg de RISORDAN et 2500 UI d’héparine avec surveillance scopée. Cathétérisme sélectif des TSA à l'aide d'une sonde Simmons 2 Glide 5F + poche à pression + valve en Y. Pas de complication per-procédure. Fermeture artérielle par bracelet compressif à dégonfler progressivement en 4h. Il est précisé au patient qu'il ne doit pas réaliser de sollicitation importante de ce bras pendant 24 h.

Produit de contraste :

[]

RESULTAT :

Absence d'anévrisme, de malformation artérioveineuse ou de fistule durale mise en évidence sur les séries angiographiques (carotide interne droite, carotide externe droite, artère vertébrale droite, carotide commune gauche). Par ailleurs calibre régulier et perméabilité normale des artères intracrâniennes. Pas d'anomalie notable du drainage veineux cérébral.

CONCLUSION :

Anomalie vasculaire. Selon le protocole de service, nous discuterons de la prise en charge en réunion de concertation pluridisciplinaire.

translation:
Thoracic CT Angiography  
Date: 06/16/2018  

INDICATION:  
Sudden onset dyspnea with elevated pressures on the right side, non-compliant inferior vena cava. Evaluation for pulmonary embolism.  

TECHNIQUE:  
Helical thoracic CT scan performed following contrast administration. "Smart prep" protocol.  
Contrast medium  
DLP at 217 mGy.cm.  

RESULTS:  
No detectable pulmonary embolism down to the subsegmental level.  
No dilation of the pulmonary artery trunk or right heart chambers. No early venous reflux into the vena cava.  
Calcifications in the aortic arch with no other identifiable aortic abnormalities.  
Coronary calcifications.  
No mediastinal or axillary lymphadenopathy.  
No pleural or pericardial thickening or effusion.  
Thickening of the bronchial walls consistent with bronchopathy, without bronchial impaction or alveolar infection focus.  
No suspicious pulmonary intraparenchymal nodules or mass syndrome.  
No detectable mass syndrome on slices through the upper abdomen.  
No suspicious bone lesions detected at this level. Multilevel dorsal spondyloarthritis.  

CONCLUSION:  
No detectable pulmonary embolism.  
Bronchopathy without signs of pulmonary infection.

translation:
Brain CT Scan
Date: 05/19/2019

INDICATION:

Evaluation of head trauma in a patient on anticoagulant therapy.

TECHNIQUE:

Non-contrast helical scan.

Contrast Agent:

None

RESULTS:

There is a spontaneously hyperdense right hemispheric subdural collection measuring up to 9 mm in maximum thickness, causing a mass effect with approximately 5 mm of subfalcine herniation. No associated uncal or tonsillar herniation is observed. There is contiguous subarachnoid hemorrhage. A subcentimeter left frontal subcutaneous hematoma is present without associated bony injury. No parenchymal involvement is noted. The cisterns and ventricles are intact. The paranasal sinuses are well-aerated.

CONCLUSION:

Acute right hemispheric subdural hematoma with a maximum thickness of 9 mm, causing approximately 5 mm of subfalcine herniation, associated with contiguous subarachnoid hemorrhage.

translation:
BODY SCAN  
Date: 05/20/2018  

INDICATION:  
Multiple trauma from a motor vehicle accident with no specific focal point.  
Negative FAST ultrasound.  

TECHNIQUE:  
The examination was performed without contrast on the brain, followed by a helical sequence with arterial contrast injection on the supra-aortic trunks and the entire aorta. Portal phase acquisition was done on the abdomen and pelvis.  

RESULTS:  

Cerebral findings:  
No intra-parenchymal or peri-cerebral hemorrhagic lesions.  
No mass effect. Midline structures are intact.  
No ventricular dilation.  
Basal cisterns have normal morphology.  
No pneumocephalus.  
No fractures.  

Cervical findings:  
No visible traumatic bone lesions.  
No dissection of the supra-aortic trunks.  

Thoracic findings:  
No pleural or pericardial fluid or air effusion.  
No parenchymal contusion.  
No rupture of the aortic isthmus.  

Abdominal and pelvic findings:  
No intra- or retroperitoneal fluid or air effusion.  
No traumatic lesions of the liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands, or kidneys.  
Normal appearance of the aorta and mesenteric vessels.  
No digestive distension or thickening of the digestive walls.  
Bladder is unremarkable.  

Bone window analysis shows no evidence of traumatic lesions in the spine or pelvis.  

CONCLUSION:  
No traumatic lesions.

BODYSCANNER
 le 20/03/2021


INDICATION
AVP moto, traumatisme facial. Probable épistaxis postérieur. Douleurs du bassin. Hyperlactatémie à 4. Fast écho négative.

TECHNIQUE.
Acquisition TDM en contraste spontané sur l'encéphale, puis après injection de produit de contraste au temps artériel sur les troncs supra-aortiques, le thorax et l'abdomen jusqu'aux genoux, portal sur l'abdomen et le pelvis.
Complément effectué par une acquisition tardive à 8 minutes sur l'appareil urinaire.
PDC :
DLP sur l'encéphale: mGy.cm DLP sur le tronc : mGy cm. 

RESULTATS
Au niveau encéphalique :
Petite lame d'hémorragie méningée pariétale bilatérale à hauteur du vertex.
Hémorragie méningée pariéto-occipitale droite avec petites contusions hémorragiques millimétriques associées.
Pas d'œdème cérébral ou d'effet de masse.
Pas d'engagement cérébral ou d'hydrocéphalie.
Pas d'hyperdensité spontanée décelable au sein des vaisseaux intracrâniens.
Pas de plage d'ischémie cortico-sous-corticale récente.
Fracture du rocher droit extralabyrinthique s'étendant à l'os tympanal avec hémotympan et comblement partiel des cellules mastoïdiennes.

-Important fracas du massif facial avec aspect de Lefort 3 bilatéral associant une fracture passant par la racine du nez, une fracture comminutive des os propres du nez déplacée, une fracture de la lame papyracée de manière bilatérale, une fracture passant par les parois latérales des orbites et des arcades zygomatiques, une fracture bilatérale des ptérygoïdes.
-Fracture de toutes les parois du sinus maxillaire gauche avec enfoncement de la paroi latérale et du plancher de l'orbite avec esquille intrasinusale. Trait de fracture comminutif du plancher de l'orbite passant par le canal du V2 gauche. Incarcération graisseuse orbitaire gauche sans incarcération musculaire. 
-Fracture passant par le canal lacrymal gauche.
-Trait de fracture passant niveau de l'apex orbitaire gauche. 
-Fracture de la lame papyracée et de la paroi supérieure du sinus sphénoïdal gauche avec petite bulle de pneumocéphalie à hauteur du canal du nerf optique gauche en faveur d'une brèche ostéoméningée.
-Fracture des parois, interne, latérale et supérieure du sinus maxillaire droit.
-Fracture du plancher de l'orbite droit sans signe d'incarcération. 
-Fracture du toit de l'orbite droit avec probable brèche ostéoméningée sans pneumocéphalie toutefois individualisable en regard.
Important pneumorbite bilatérale.

BODY SCAN
March 20, 2021

INDICATION
Motorcycle accident, facial trauma. Suspected posterior epistaxis. Pelvic pain. Elevated lactate level at 4. Negative FAST ultrasound.

TECHNIQUE
CT scan performed without contrast on the brain, followed by contrast-enhanced arterial phase imaging of the supra-aortic trunks, chest, and abdomen down to the knees, and portal phase imaging of the abdomen and pelvis. Additional delayed imaging at 8 minutes for the urinary system.
Contrast Dose:
DLP for the brain: mGy.cm DLP for the trunk: mGy cm.

RESULTS
Brain:
Small bilateral parietal subarachnoid hemorrhage at the vertex.
Right parieto-occipital subarachnoid hemorrhage with small associated hemorrhagic contusions.
No cerebral edema or mass effect.
No brain herniation or hydrocephalus.
No detectable spontaneous hyperdensity within the intracranial vessels.
No recent cortico-subcortical ischemic area.
Fracture of the right petrous bone extending to the tympanic bone with hemotympanum and partial filling of the mastoid cells.

-Significant facial bone fractures with bilateral Le Fort III pattern involving a fracture through the nasal root, displaced comminuted fracture of the nasal bones, bilateral fracture of the lamina papyracea, fractures through the lateral walls of the orbits and zygomatic arches, and bilateral pterygoid fractures.
-Fracture of all walls of the left maxillary sinus with depression of the lateral wall and orbital floor with intrasinus bone fragment. Comminuted fracture of the orbital floor involving the left V2 canal. Left orbital fat entrapment without muscle entrapment.
-Fracture through the left lacrimal canal.
-Fracture at the level of the left orbital apex.
-Fracture of the lamina papyracea and superior wall of the left sphenoid sinus with a small pneumocephalus bubble at the left optic canal indicating a dural breach.
-Fracture of the internal, lateral, and superior walls of the right maxillary sinus.
-Fracture of the right orbital floor without signs of entrapment.
-Fracture of the right orbital roof with probable dural breach, although no pneumocephalus is visible.
Significant bilateral orbital emphysema.
No clearly identifiable fracture of the optic nerve canals or right lacrimal canal.
Bilateral maxillary and sphenoidal hemisinus.
-Non-displaced fracture of the left mandibular ramus and left parasymphyseal fracture passing between teeth 35 and 36.
Significant periorbital and right perimandibular subcutaneous emphysema.

Cervical Spine:
Satisfactory alignment of the vertebral bodies.
No post-traumatic bone lesion, dislocation, joint separation, or abnormal disc widening.
No abnormalities of the supra-aortic trunks, particularly no evidence of post-traumatic dissection.

Thorax:
No detectable hemopneumothorax.
Ground-glass opacities with thickening of the left apical interlobular septa possibly related to pulmonary contusion.
Ventilatory disturbances at the lung bases.
Small right apical paraseptal emphysema lesions.
Sliding hiatal hernia.
Integrity of the mediastinal arterial vessels, particularly the aorta.

Abdominopelvic Region:
Hemoperitoneum located beneath the bladder above the pubic symphysis, of mild to moderate volume, without identifiable active bleeding, no detectable pelvic fracture.
No identifiable ureteral injury on delayed urinary imaging. Incomplete opacification of the bladder on delayed urinary phase, not allowing formal exclusion of a bladder injury. No clearly identifiable bladder wall discontinuity on portal phase with presence of a bladder globe. The prostatic urethra is not assessable in this exam.
No hemoperitoneum or pneumoperitoneum.
No post-traumatic injury to the liver, spleen, adrenal glands, kidneys, or pancreas.
Gallbladder without stones.
No identifiable abnormalities in the digestive system, noting the exam was performed without preparation or opacification.
No post-traumatic injury to the aorta or visceral arteries.

Skeletal:
Non-displaced articular fracture of the anterior part of the left medial tibial plateau with associated lipohemarthrosis. No detectable vascular abnormality in the area.
Small non-displaced cortical fracture of the left fibular head.
No spinal or pelvic fracture.
No disjunction of the pubic symphysis or sacroiliac joints. No rib cage fracture.

CONCLUSION
-Bilateral parietal subarachnoid hemorrhage at the vertex, right parieto-occipital with small associated hemorrhagic contusions.
-Right petrous bone fracture extending to the tympanic bone.
-Significant facial bone fractures (see above report) with bilateral Le Fort III pattern, more significant fracture of both orbital floors on the left with orbital fat entrapment, no muscle entrapment, involvement of the left V2 canal, involvement of the left lacrimal canal.
-Dural breach with fracture of the lamina papyracea at the left orbital apex with a small pneumocephalus bubble, fracture at the superior part of the right orbit.
-Bifocal mandibular fracture with left parasymphyseal fracture and fracture of the left mandibular ramus.
-Left apical pulmonary contusion.
-Hemoperitoneum without active bleeding, no associated pelvic fracture. No formally identifiable ureteral injury on delayed phase. Bladder analysis is incomplete due to incomplete opacification on delayed urinary phase. The exam cannot exclude a prostatic urethral injury. Consider secondary evaluation with cysto-CT or cystoscopy after urological consultation.
-Non-displaced articular fracture of the left medial tibial plateau with lipohemarthrosis.
-Small non-displaced cortical fracture of the left fibular head.

report:
SCANNER CEREBRAL 
 le 20/05/2021

INDICATION : 
Bilan d'une première crise d'épilepsie.

TECHNIQUE :
Acquisition hélicoïdale sans puis après injection de produit de contraste iodé. 
PDC : XENETIX 350
DLP : 1019 mGy.cm

RESULTAT : 

Absence de saignement intra ou extra-axial.
Pas de collection péricérébrale.
Petite hypodensité périventriculaire au conact du toit du ventricule latéral droit aspécifique.
Pas de syndrome de masse ou de prise de contraste pathologique.
Intégrité du système cisternoventriculaire.
Pas de thrombose veineuse cérébrale.

CONCLUSION : Absence de saignement ou de processus expansif intracrânien.

report:
IRM du genou gauche
 le 12/06/2021

 
INDICATION :
Douleurs au niveau de la palpation de la corne antérieure du ménisque médial suite à une chute à vélo. Gonalgie à l'effort. Recherche d'atteinte méniscale. Pas de laxité.

TECHNIQUE : 
I.R.M. du genou gauche avec acquisition 3 plans DP Fat Sat, sagittales et coronales T1.
RESULTAT :
 
 Structures méniscales :
 Hypersignal DP Fat-Sat linéaire de la corne postérieure et de la partie moyenne du ménisque, sans irradiation vers les surfaces articulaires en faveur d'une méniscopathie dégénérative de grade II, sans argument ce jour pour une fissure méniscale. Pas d'anse de seau ou de languette méniscale.
Intégrité du ménisque externe.

 Structures ligamentaires :
  Intégrité du pivot central ainsi que des ligaments collatéraux et des tendons, quadricipital et patellaire.

 Par ailleurs :
 Pas d'oedème médullo-spongieux anormal.
Intégrité des cartilages fémoro-patellaires et fémoro-tibiaux. 
Minime lame d'épanchement intra-articulaire de quantité non significative.
Minime infiltration en hypersignal T2 en regard de l'insertion distale des tendons de la patte d'oie, sans anomalie de signal intratendineuse décelable : Bursite a minima ? À corréler à la clinique.
Pas d'anomalie des parties molles péri-articulaires.

CONCLUSION :
Méniscopathie dégénérative de grade II de la corne postérieure et de la partie moyenne du ménisque interne, sans argument ce jour pour une fissure méniscale.
Minime infiltration en hypersignal T2 fat Sat à l'insertion distale des tendons de la patte d'oie, sans anomalie de signal intratendineuse : Bursite a minima ? À corréler à la clinique.
translation:
MRI of the Left Knee  
Date: 06/12/2021

INDICATION:  
Pain upon palpation of the anterior horn of the medial meniscus following a bicycle fall. Knee pain during exertion. Evaluation for meniscal injury. No laxity.

TECHNIQUE:  
MRI of the left knee with 3-plane DP Fat Sat acquisition, sagittal and coronal T1 sequences.

RESULTS:

Meniscal Structures:  
Linear DP Fat-Sat hyperintensity in the posterior horn and midsection of the meniscus, without extension to the articular surfaces, suggestive of a grade II degenerative meniscal disease, with no current evidence of a meniscal tear. No bucket handle or meniscal flap present. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Ligamentous Structures:  
The central pivot, collateral ligaments, and the quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Additional Findings:  
No abnormal bone marrow edema.  
Intact femoropatellar and femorotibial cartilage.  
Minimal intra-articular effusion of non-significant quantity.  
Minimal T2 hyperintense infiltration at the distal insertion of the pes anserinus tendons, with no detectable intratendinous signal abnormality: Minimal bursitis? Correlate clinically.  
No abnormalities in the periarticular soft tissues.

CONCLUSION:  
Grade II degenerative meniscal disease of the posterior horn and midsection of the medial meniscus, with no current evidence of a meniscal tear.  
Minimal T2 Fat Sat hyperintense infiltration at the distal insertion of the pes anserinus tendons, with no intratendinous signal abnormality: Minimal bursitis? Correlate clinically.

report:
IRM du genou gauche
le 15/12/2022

INDICATION :
Chute sur les genoux avec douleurs à la face interne. 
Recherche d'une pathologie méniscale.

TECHNIQUE : 
I.R.M. du genou gauche avec acquisition 3 plans DP Fat Sat, sagittales et coronales T1.

RESULTAT : 
Importante infiltration des parties molles autour du ligament collatéral médial, sans désinsertion en faveur d'une entorse grade II. 
Minime plage d'œdème sous-chondral en regard de l'insertion fémorale avec un aspect épaissi du ligament regard. 
Fissure longitudinale du ménisque médial atteignant le bord libre grade 2a.
Méniscopathie dégénérative latérale avec une subluxation latérale méniscale, sans fissure.
Pas d'anomalie du ligament collatéral latéral, des ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur, des tendons de l'appareil extenseur et de la patte d'oie.
Plage de contusion osseuse de la partie postérieure du plateau tibial latéral, sans fracture sous chondrale visualisée.
Pas d'épanchement articulaire, ni kyste poplité.
Pas d'anomalie des cartilages fémoro-tibiaux et patellaire.
Pas d'infiltration de la graisse de Hoffa évocatrice de syndrome de friction patellaire. 
Pas d'anomalie visualisée au sein des parties molles.







CONCLUSION : 
Aspect d'entorse du LCM grade 2 avec une plage de contusion postérieure du pateau tibial latéral.
translation:
MRI of the Left Knee  
Date: 12/15/2022  

INDICATION:  
Fall onto the knees with pain on the inner side. Evaluation for meniscal pathology.  

TECHNIQUE:  
MRI of the left knee with 3-plane DP Fat Sat, sagittal and coronal T1 sequences.  

RESULTS:  
Significant soft tissue infiltration around the medial collateral ligament, without detachment, consistent with a grade II sprain.  
Minimal subchondral edema at the femoral insertion with thickening of the ligament in the area.  
Longitudinal tear of the medial meniscus reaching the free edge, grade 2a.  
Degenerative lateral meniscal changes with lateral meniscal subluxation, without tear.  
No abnormalities of the lateral collateral ligament, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, extensor mechanism tendons, or pes anserinus.  
Bone bruise on the posterior part of the lateral tibial plateau, with no subchondral fracture seen.  
No joint effusion or popliteal cyst.  
No abnormalities of the femorotibial and patellar cartilage.  
No infiltration of Hoffa's fat pad suggestive of patellar friction syndrome.  
No abnormalities seen within the soft tissues.  

CONCLUSION:  
Findings consistent with a grade 2 sprain of the MCL with a posterior bone bruise on the lateral tibial plateau.

MRI of the left knee with 3-plane DP Fat Sat, sagittal and coronal T1 sequences.  

RESULTS:  
Significant soft tissue infiltration around the medial collateral ligament, without detachment, consistent with a grade II sprain.  
Minimal subchondral edema at the femoral insertion with thickening of the ligament in the area.  
Longitudinal tear of the medial meniscus reaching the free edge, grade 2a.  
Degenerative lateral meniscal changes with lateral meniscal subluxation, without tear.  
No abnormalities of the lateral collateral ligament, anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments, extensor mechanism tendons, or pes anserinus.  
Bone bruise on the posterior part of the lateral tibial plateau, with no subchondral fracture seen.  
No joint effusion or popliteal cyst.  
No abnormalities of the femorotibial and patellar cartilage.  
No infiltration of Hoffa's fat pad suggestive of patellar friction syndrome.  
No abnormalities seen within the soft tissues.  

CONCLUSION:  
No evidence of a grade 2 sprain of the MCL with a posterior bone bruise on the lateral tibial plateau.

report:
IRM CRÂNE 
 le 25/03/2023

INDICATION : Suivi pathologie anévrismale

TECHNIQUE :
Séquences axiale diffusion, axiale flair, axiale T2EG, 3D temps de vol

RESULTAT : Comparativement à l'IRM du 18/12/2023
Stabilité du tatouage hémosidérinique cortical diffus prédominant au niveau ponto mésencéphalique et de l'hémisphère gauche séquellaire de l'hémorragie sous arachnoïdienne.
Séquelles ischémiques chroniques cortico-sous-corticales diffuses apparaissant en hypersignal FLAIR, prédominant au niveau de l'hémisphère gauche, épargnant l'étage sous-tentoriel. Évolution atrophique attendue avec majoration de la dilatation passive du ventricule latéral gauche.
Stigmates de DVE frontale droite et de capteur de pression intracrânienne frontal gauche.
Occlusion complète des anévrismes carotido communicant postérieur gauche et para ophtalmique droit.
Pas de néo-anévrisme.

CONCLUSION : 
Occlusion complète des anévrismes carotido communicant postérieur gauche et para ophtalmique droit.
Importantes séquelles ischémiques bilatérales.
translation:
MRI BRAIN  
March 25, 2023

INDICATION: Follow-up of aneurysmal pathology

TECHNIQUE: Axial diffusion sequences, axial FLAIR, axial T2*, 3D time-of-flight

RESULTS: Compared to the MRI from December 18, 2023
Stability of the diffuse cortical hemosiderin staining, predominantly at the pontomesencephalic level and in the left hemisphere, as a sequela of the subarachnoid hemorrhage.
Chronic ischemic changes in the diffuse cortico-subcortical areas appearing as FLAIR hyperintensities, predominantly in the left hemisphere, sparing the infratentorial region. Expected atrophic evolution with increased passive dilation of the left lateral ventricle.
Signs of right frontal EVD and left frontal intracranial pressure sensor.
Complete occlusion of the left posterior communicating carotid aneurysm and the right paraophthalmic aneurysm.
No new aneurysm.

CONCLUSION:
Complete occlusion of the left posterior communicating carotid aneurysm and the right paraophthalmic aneurysm.
Significant bilateral ischemic sequelae.

report:
IRM CEREBRALE 
 le 3/10/2022


INDICATION
Bilan d'anévrisme. Examen corréler aux antériorités.


TECHNIQUE
Séquences axiales FLAIR, Diffusion multi-b, T2*, TOF willis avec reformatage.
3RX1 sans et avec injection de gadolinium.


RÉSULTATS
Absence de processus expansif intra ou extra axial.
Absence d'effet de masse ou d'engagement.
Absence d'hydrocéphalie.
Absence de recanalisation anévrysmale. Packing de coils en place. Perméabilité des artères porteuses.
Atrophie sous corticale avec troubles de résorption sub épendymaire.
Atrophie corticale diffuse.
Stabilité des hygromes sous-duraux, de la leucopathie, du volume ventriculaire, des cicatrices porencéphaliques et de gliose frontale droite, du tatouage hémosidérinique bifrontal. Artéfact prothétique hémisphérique gauche.
La séquence diffusion élimine un accident ischémique en voie de constitution ou récemment constitué.
Leucopathie vasculaire avec hypersignaux bilatéraux des centres semi ovales.


CONCLUSION
Absence de recanalisation anévrysmale. Poursuite de la surveillance. Le patient sera revu en consultation de NRI.
translation:
BRAIN MRI  
10/3/2022  

INDICATION  
Aneurysm evaluation. Correlate with previous exams.  

TECHNIQUE  
Axial FLAIR, multi-b Diffusion, T2*, TOF Willis with reformatting.  
3RX1 without and with gadolinium contrast.  

RESULTS  
No intra- or extra-axial mass lesions.  
No mass effect or herniation.  
No hydrocephalus.  
No aneurysmal recanalization. Coil packing in place. Patency of the parent arteries.  
Subcortical atrophy with subependymal resorption issues.  
Diffuse cortical atrophy.  
Stability of subdural hygromas, leukoencephalopathy, ventricular volume, porencephalic scars and right frontal gliosis, bifrontal hemosiderin staining. Left hemispheric prosthetic artifact.  
Diffusion sequence rules out an evolving or recent ischemic event.  
Vascular leukoencephalopathy with bilateral hyperintensities in the centrum semiovale.  

CONCLUSION  
No aneurysmal recanalization. Continued monitoring recommended. The patient will be seen in an NRI consultation.

 le 6/3/2023

-Prise de contraste artérielle nodulaire sur le bord postérieure de la zone de thermoablation du segment VIII (8mm) avec wash out central, sans hypersignal diffusion et avec capsule, sans franche restriction sur la cartographie ADC LIRADS IV
- Prise de contraste artérielle nodulaire (10 mm) présentant les même caractéristiques d'imagerie au contact du bord postérieur à la jonction VII/VI LIRADS IV

Statut post-thérapeutique de thermo-ablation des segments III et VIII, et IV a hépatiques sans signe de récidive locale visible en regard (classées LI-RADS-TR non viables).

Perméabilité conservée du reste du réseau veineux porte et des veines hépatiques.

translation:
LIVER MRI  
Date: 3/6/2023

INDICATION:
Monitoring of multiple thermal ablations in the context of HCC on cirrhosis.

TECHNIQUE:
Axial T1 in-phase/out-of-phase sequences, diffusion, axial T2 with fat saturation, coronal T2, axial and coronal T2, T1 with fat saturation after dynamic contrast injection.
Contrast agent: 

RESULTS: Comparison with MRI from 2/4/2022

Progressive lesions:
- Nodular arterial enhancement on the posterior edge of the thermal ablation zone in segment VIII (8mm) with central washout, no diffusion hyperintensity, and with capsule, without clear restriction on ADC mapping, LI-RADS IV.
- Nodular arterial enhancement (10mm) with similar imaging characteristics at the posterior edge at the VII/VI junction, LI-RADS IV.

Known lesions:
Post-therapeutic status of thermal ablation in hepatic segments III and VIII, and IVa with no visible signs of local recurrence (classified as LI-RADS-TR non-viable).

Regarding portal thrombosis:
- Known right segmental portal occlusion with stable perfusion abnormalities.
- Persistence of a chronic non-tumoral signal occlusion of the left portal branch without associated portal cavernoma.

Other notable findings:
Preserved patency of the rest of the portal venous system and hepatic veins.
No dilation of intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts.
Gallbladder with thin walls containing a few dependent microliths.
Morphological integrity of the pancreas. Main pancreatic duct is thin and regular.
Simple cortical renal cyst in the left kidney, Bosniak 1.
On thoracic slices, there is evidence of apical myocardial scarring of the LV (not the RV as previously noted in error) without visible thrombus.

CONCLUSION:
2 progressive LI-RADS IV nodules:
- Segment VIII (8mm)
- Posterior edge of the junction of segments VII and VI (10mm).

report:
I.R.M. myocardique
 le : 12/07/2024

 
INDICATION :
Suspicion de syndrome de Tako Tsubo.

TECHNIQUE 
Il a été réalisé des séquences petit axe et 4 cavités perfusion, petit axe, grand axe et 4 cavités, rehaussement tardif, petit axe   et 4 cavités Ciné.
DOTAREM 30 ml ,lot 23GD079A01.

RESULTATS
La fraction d'éjection ventriculaire gauche est  normale mesurée à 51%.
Sous réserve d'importants artéfacts au niveau de la base du VG, rendant l'analyse impossible à ce niveau, pas de franche anomalie de la cinétique segmentaire ou globale individualisable sur le reste du VG, en particulier, il n'est pas retrouvé d'akinésie en région antéro-septo-apicale ou septoapicale ce jour.
Épaisseur myocardique semblant conservée.
Pas de dilatation ventriculaire gauche : VTDVG=126 ml =57ml/m², VTSVG=61ml.
Ventricule droit non dilaté, de bonne fonction systolique : FEVD=51% VTDVD=59 ml= 27ml/m², VTSVD= 29ml. 
Après injection de gadolinium, il n'est pas visualisé de trouble perfusionnel.
Sur les séquences de réhaussement tardif, découverte d'une prise de contraste intramyocardique, inféro-latéro-basale sur environ deux segments, d'allure plutôt sous-endocardique non transmurale. L'existence d'un trouble de la cinétique segmentaire à ce niveau n'est pas évaluable compte tenu des artéfacts sur les séquences ciné à ce niveau.
Pas d'autre prise de contraste intramyocardique décelable, en particulier, au niveau antéro-septo-apical ou septoapical.
Par ailleurs, absence de masse intracardiaque anormale décelable.
Pas d'épaississement, d'épanchement ou de prise de contraste péricardique anormale.
Pas d'anomalie extracardiaque.

CONCLUSION
VG normocinétique et normokinétique.
Pas d'anomalie de la cinétique segmentaire ou de prise de contraste anormale retrouvée au niveau antéro-septo-apical ou septoapical.
Découverte d'une prise de contraste intramyocardique d'allure plutôt sous-endocardique inféro-latéro-basale sur environ deux segments, avec analyse de la cinétique segmentaire en regard impossible ce jour en raison d'artéfacts : nécrose myocardique ?
À confronter à l'ensemble du dossier clinicobiologique et d'imagerie à recontrôler en fonction.
translation:
Cardiac MRI  
Date: 07/12/2024

INDICATION:  
Suspected Tako Tsubo syndrome.

TECHNIQUE:  
Short-axis and 4-chamber perfusion sequences were performed, along with short-axis, long-axis, and 4-chamber late enhancement, and short-axis and 4-chamber Cine sequences. DOTAREM 30 ml, lot 23GD079A01.

RESULTS:  
The left ventricular ejection fraction is normal, measured at 51%.  
Due to significant artifacts at the base of the LV, analysis is impossible at this level. No distinct segmental or global wall motion abnormalities are identifiable in the rest of the LV. Specifically, no akinesia is found in the antero-septal-apical or septoapical region today.  
Myocardial thickness appears preserved.  
No left ventricular dilation: LVEDV = 126 ml = 57 ml/m², LVESV = 61 ml.  
The right ventricle is not dilated, with good systolic function: RVEF = 51%, RVEDV = 59 ml = 27 ml/m², RVESV = 29 ml.  
After gadolinium injection, no perfusion defect is visualized.  
On late enhancement sequences, an intramyocardial contrast uptake is discovered in the infero-lateral-basal region over approximately two segments, appearing rather subendocardial and non-transmural. The presence of a segmental wall motion abnormality at this level cannot be assessed due to artifacts on the cine sequences at this level.  
No other intramyocardial contrast uptake is detectable, particularly in the antero-septal-apical or septoapical region.  
Additionally, no abnormal intracardiac mass is detectable.  
No abnormal pericardial thickening, effusion, or contrast uptake.  
No extracardiac abnormalities.

CONCLUSION:  
The LV is normokinetic and normodynamic.  
No segmental wall motion abnormalities or abnormal contrast uptake are found in the antero-septal-apical or septoapical region.  
Discovery of an intramyocardial contrast uptake appearing rather subendocardial in the infero-lateral-basal region over approximately two segments, with segmental wall motion analysis at this level impossible today due to artifacts: myocardial necrosis?  
To be correlated with the overall clinical, biological, and imaging findings for follow-up as needed.

report:
Esame eseguito prima e dopo somministrazione di m.d.c. e.v. (100 ml di iomeron 400) in paziente con sindrome di Budd-Chiari.
Fegato modicamente aumentato di dimensioni in particolare si apprezza ipertrofia del lobo caudato. Il parenchima epatico mostra diffuso enhancement disomogeneo con aspetto a "noce moscata" e le vene sovraepatiche non sono visualizzabili. Presenza di numerosi shunt venosi intraepatici con la formazione di circoli collaterali che drenano nella vena cava superiore. 
Presenza di alcune formazioni epatiche nodulari, marcatamente ipervascolari in fase arteriosa, ed isodense in fase portale e tardiva, la maggiore delle quali in 7 (1 cm), riferibili a noduli tipo iperplasia nodulare focale. 
Pervio il sistema portale e la vena mesenterica superiore.
Regolare aspetto di pancreas, reni, surreni, e milza.
Vescica scarsamente repleta non valutabile.
Presenza di formazione cistica semplice di 3 cm nell'annesso di destra da riferire verosimilmente a follicolo dominante.
Non evidenza di linfoadenomegalie.
Assenza di versamento libero.
CONCLUSIONI : il fegato presenta alterazioni compatibili con Sindromi di Budd-Chiari in fase cronica. Multipli noduli FNH-like. Si suggerisce di effettuare i controlli futuri con RM con mezzo di contrasto epatospecifico.
translation:
CT exam acquired before and after i.v. contrast agent injection (100 ml of Iomeron 400) in patient with Budd Chiari syndrome.
Liver is slightly increased in size, namely with caudate lobe hypertrophy. Liver parenchyma has inhomogeneous enhancement with “nutmeg” appearance and hepatic veins are not visualized. There are innumerable intrahepatic venous shunts with collateral veins draining into superior cava vein. 
Multiple liver nodules, highly hypervascular on arterial phase, and isoattenuating on portal venous and delayed phases, with the largest one being in segment 7 (1 cm), which are suggestive of FNH-like lesions.

report:
Esame eseguito in urgenza nelle sole condizioni di base in paziente con colica addominale.
In quadro di diverticolosi del colon e del sigma, si rileva in corrispondenza del colon discendente, al terzo distale, si apprezza sfumata iperdensità dell'adipe periviscerale nel cui contesto si apprezzano minute bolle aeree, espressione di perforazione diverticolare. Coesiste discreta quota di aria libera in addome.
Fegato di regolare morfovolumetria a densità ridotta come da steatosi. Multiple puntiformi calcificazioni distrofiche in S2.
Colecisti contratta non valutabile . Vie biliari non dilatate.
Non evidenti alterazioni a carattere d'urgenza di milza, pancreas, surreni e reni (lieve ispessimento dei setti reno-renali e reno-fasciali).
Vescica non repleta, non valutabile.
Prostata aumentata di volume (RX max 5 cm) a densità omogenea.
Non evidenza di versamento libero in addome né significative linfadenopatie addomino-pelviche.
Piccola ernia iatale.
CONCLUSIONI
Diverticolite perforata
translation:
Exam acquired in the urgency setting, without i.v. contrast, in patient with abdominal pain.
In the presence of colonic and sigmoid diverticulosis, there is in the distal third of the descending colon a mild hyperattenuation of the perivisceral fat with some locules of free air, indicating perforated diverticulitis. There is also moderate free air in the abdomen.
Liver has normal morphology and volumetry, with reduced density indicating steatosis. Multiple tiny dystrophic calcifications in segment 2.
Gallbladder is collapsed, not assessable. Biliary tree is not dilated.
There is not any urgent lesion in the spleen, pancreas, adrenals, and kidneys (minimal thickening of the reno-renal and reno-fascial septa).
Bladder is almost empty, not assessable.
Prostate is enlarged (maximum diameter 5 cm), with homogeneous density.
No free fluid or enlarged lymph nodes.
Small hiatal hernia.
CONCLUSION
Perforated diverticulitis

report:
Esame eseguito senza e con mdc ev per "dolore addominale e leucocitosi in paziente con malattia di Crohn". 
Ispessimento parietale concentrico substenosante il lume dell'ultima ansa ileale, con spiccato enhancement mucosale, come da malattia di Crohn in fase attiva, ed associata congestione dei vasa recta afferenti che determinano "aspetto a pettine".
A monte di tale tratto d'ansa substenotico, le anse ileali medio-distali presentano "aspetto impacchettato"  (fistole entero-enteriche complicate da fenomeni aderenziali?) con lume ectasico per un breve tratto (RX max 5 cm) ove si evidenzia livello idro-aereo.
Non ulteriori significativi livelli idro-aerei.
Non versamento né aria  libera in addome.
Alcuni subcentimetrici linfonodi nel contesto del ventaglio mesenteriale. 
Splenomegalia (DL 14 cm) a densità omogenea. 
Non alterazioni a carattere d'urgenza di fegato (lesione focale di 6 mm sfumatamente ipodensa al VII segmento epatico), pancreas, surreni, reni e vescica. 
CONCLUSIONI
Malattia di Crohn in fase attiva.
translation:
Exam acquired before and after i.v. c.a. injection for “abdominal pain and leukocytosis in a patient with Crohn’s disease”.
Substenotic concentric parietal thickening of the last ileal loop, with marked mucosal enhancement, suggestive of Crohn’s disease in the active phase, with associated engorgement of the vasa recta with the “comb sign” appearance. 
The mid-distal ileal loops located upstream to the substenotic one, show a “packed” appearance (entero-enteric fistulae complicated by adhesions?) with enlarged lumen for a small tract (maximum diameter 5 cm) where an air-fluid level is evident.
There are not further significant air-fluid levels.
No free fluid or free air in the abdomen.
Some subcentimetric nodes in the mesentery.
Splenomegaly (CCL 14 cm) with homogeneous density.
There is not any urgent lesion in the liver (focal slightly hypoattenuating lesion of 6 mm  in segment 7), pancreas, adrenals, kidney and bladder.  
CONCLUSIONS
Crohn’s disease in an active phase.

report:
Indagine eseguita con trasduttore ad elevata frequenza.
Regolare aspetto di vene femorali comuni, femorali profonde, femorali superficiali e poplitee, che si presentano pervie e comprimibili, in assenza di reflusso alle manovre funzionali. Assenza di lesioni trombotiche. Segni ecodoppler negativi per incontinenza degli osti safenopopliteo e safenofemorale; regolare flusso anterogrado di piccola e grande safena.
Esiti di trombosi della vena poplitea dx in atto riabitata e pervia al flusso. Presenza in corrispondenza dei piani più superficiali di varicosità (correlato a circoli superficiali).
translation:
US exam performed with a high frequency transducer.
Regular appearance of common femoral veins, deep femoral veins, superficial femoral veins and popliteal veins, which are patent and compressible, in the absence of any reflux after functional maneuvers. Absence of venous thrombosis. Negative Doppler US signs for incontinence of the saphenopopliteal and saphenofemoral junctions; normal antegrade flow of small and great saphenous veins.
Presence of varicosities in the most superficial planes (due to superficial collateral veins).

report:
Esame eseguito senza e con mdc ev (60 ml di Iomeron 400) in urgenza per sospetta embolia polmonare.
Difetto di riempimento dei rami segmentari e subsegmentari polmonari tributari ai segmenti posterobasale e basale mediale del lobo inferiore destro, e dei rami segmentari e subsegmentari tributari ai segmenti apicale, basale posteriore e laterale del lobo inferiore sinistro.
Coesistono trombi endoluminali flottanti in corrispondenza del ramo destro del tronco principale dell'a.polmonare, e del ramo lobare inferiore dell'arteria polmonare sinistra.
Tali reperti sono compatibili con un quadro di embolia polmonare secondaria a TVP.
Nel segmento posterobasale del lobo inferiore sinistro sede basale posteriore, si rileva area di addensamento parenchimale con broncogramma aereo nel contesto, che nelle sequenze post-contrastografiche presenta componente centrale ipodensa, come da possibile sede di area infartuale.
Regolare aspetto degli organi mediastinici.
Minimo versamento pleurico bilaterale.
Non versamento pericardico
Calcificazioni ateromasiche dell'aorta e delle arterie coronarie.
Alcuni linfonodi calcifici si segnalano in sede ilare destra e sottocarenale (RX max 1,2 cm).
translation:
Exam performed without and with i.v. contrast agent injection (60 ml of Iomeron 400) in emergency in the suspicion of pulmonary embolism.
Thrombotic defects of the segmental and subsegmental pulmonary branches tributary to the posterobasal and medial basal segments of the right lower lobe, and of the segmental and subsegmental branches tributary to the apical, posterior basal and lateral segments of the left lower lobe.
Floating endoluminal thrombi coexist in the right branch of the main trunk of the pulmonary artery, as well as in the lower lobar branch of the left pulmonary artery.
These findings are compatible with pulmonary embolism secondary to DVT.
In the posterobasal segment of the left lower lobe, there is a parenchymal consolidation with air bronchogram, that show an hypoattenuating central area after i.v. contrast agent injection, suggestive for lung infarction.
Normal appearance of the mediastinal organs.
Minimal bilateral pleural effusion.
No pericardial effusion.
Atherosclerosis of the aorta and of the coronary arteries.
Some calcific nodes are evident in the right hilar and subcarinal areas (maximum diameter 1.2 cm).

Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten.  
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Intravenöse Applikation von 100 ml Imeron 400 und Akquisition des Thorax/Abdomens/Beckens in venöser Kontrastmittelphase. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 760,90 mGy*cm.

Es liegt eine konventionelle Aufnahme des Thorax vom selben Tag zum Vergleich vor.

Leber weitestgehend glatt berandet, homogen kontrastiert und ohne Nachweis einer fokalen Läsion. Gallenblase zartwandig, flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne röntgendichte Konkremente. report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patientin mit Verschlechterung einer vorbestehenden Beinparese links seit gestern. Hinweis auf Re-infarkt? Blutung? 
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native Inkremental-CT des Neurokraniums. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 800,40 mGy*cm.
Befund: 
Es liegen mehrere Voruntersuchungen zum Vergleich vor.  
Keine blutungssuspekten Hyperdensitäten. Keine Ischämiefrühzeichen. Kein sich demarkierender Territorialinfarkt. Bekannte alte Defektareale rechts okzipital, rechts parietal sowie rechts frontal präzentral. Konstante leichte Asymmetrie der Seitenventrikel zugunsten rechts. Mittelständiger Interhemisphärenspalt. Basale Zisternen gut abgrenzbar und nicht eingeengt. Nativ kein Hinweis auf eine Raumforderung. Keine Fraktur der Schädelkalotte. Geringe Hyperostosis interna frontalis. Soweit miterfasst, frei belüftete Nasennebenhöhlen und Mastoidzellen ohne Spiegelbildung oder Schleimhautschwellung.  
Beurteilung: 
Keine intrakranielle Blutung. Keine frische oder sich demarkierende Ischämie. Mehrere alte Infarktareale.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with worsening of a pre-existing left leg paresis since yesterday. Indication of re-infarction? Bleeding?The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Examination Technique:Digital overview radiographs. Native incremental CT of the neurocranium. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product 800.40 mGy*cm.
Findings:Multiple previous examinations are available for comparison.
No hyperdensities suggestive of bleeding. No early signs of ischemia. No demarcating territorial infarct. Known old defect areas in the right occipital, right parietal, and right frontal precentral regions. Consistent mild asymmetry of the lateral ventricles, favoring the right side. Midline interhemispheric fissure. Basal cisterns are well delineated and not narrowed. No indication of a space-occupying lesion on native imaging. No skull cap fracture. Mild hyperostosis interna frontalis. As far as included, the paranasal sinuses and mastoid cells are well aerated, without fluid levels or mucosal swelling.
Conclusion:No intracranial bleeding. No fresh or demarcating ischemia. Multiple old infarct areas.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patientin mit Nierenkolik beidseits und Mikrohämaturie. Konkrement?  
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native Akquisition des Abdomens/Beckens in Niedrigdosistechnik. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 110,70 mGy*cm. 
Befund: 
Es liegt eine externe CT des Abdomens Beckens vom 09.01.2023 Vergleich vor.  
Leber glatt berandet und nativ ohne Nachweis einer fokalen Läsion. Gallenblase zartwandig, flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne röntgendichte Konkremente. Keine Erweiterung der intra- oder extrahepatischen Gallenwege. Pankreas organtypisch lobuliert, kein Aufstau des Ductus pancreaticus. Milz nicht vergrößert. Nebennieren beidseits zart. Nieren orthotop gelegen. 4 mm großes Konkrement im linken Harnleiterostium. Moderate Erweiterung des linken Ureters und des linken Nierenbeckenkelchsystems entsprechend eines Harnstau Grad II. Kein Konkrement im rechten Nierenbeckenkelchsystem oder rechten Ureter. Kein Harnstau rechts. Harnblase flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne fokale Wandverdickung. Prostata mit einzelnen Verkalkungen. Keine pathologisch distendierten Dünn- oder Dickdarmschlingen. Keine freie Luft oder Flüssigkeit. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten oder konfigurierten intraabdominellen oder inguinalen Lymphknoten soweit nativ beurteilbar. Keine pneumonischen Infiltrate in den miterfassten basalen Lungenabschnitten. Keine malignitätssuspekten ossären Läsionen. Beginnende degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderung. Keine frischen Frakturen. 
Beurteilung: 
4 mm großes Konkrement im linken Harnleiterostium mit konsekutivem Harnstau Grad II links. 
Kein Konkrement im rechten Nierenbeckenkelchsystem oder Ureter, kein Harnstau rechts.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with bilateral renal colic and microhematuria. Calculus?The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Examination Technique:Digital overview radiographs. Native acquisition of the abdomen/pelvis using low-dose technique. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product 110.70 mGy*cm.
Findings:An external CT of the abdomen and pelvis from 09.01.2023 is available for comparison.
The liver has smooth edges and shows no evidence of focal lesions on native imaging. The gallbladder is thin-walled, fluid-filled, and without radiodense stones. No dilation of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. The pancreas is typically lobulated, with no dilation of the pancreatic duct. The spleen is not enlarged. Both adrenal glands are slim. The kidneys are orthotopically positioned. A 4 mm calculus is present at the left ureteral orifice. Moderate dilation of the left ureter and the left renal pelvis-calyx system, corresponding to Grade II hydronephrosis. No calculus in the right renal pelvis-calyx system or right ureter. No hydronephrosis on the right side. The urinary bladder is fluid-filled and without focal wall thickening. The prostate shows some calcifications. No pathologically distended small or large bowel loops. No free air or fluid. No pathologically enlarged or configured intra-abdominal or inguinal lymph nodes as far as can be assessed natively. No pneumonic infiltrates in the included basal lung sections. No osseous lesions suspicious for malignancy. Beginning degenerative changes in the spine. No fresh fractures.
Conclusion:4 mm calculus at the left ureteral orifice with consequent Grade II hydronephrosis on the left side.No calculus in the right renal pelvis-calyx system or ureter, no hydronephrosis on the right side.

Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patientin mit Z.n. Sturz, jetzt Schmerzen im Bereich der LWS und des Beckens. Frage nach Fraktur.  
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Native Akquisition der LWS und des Beckens. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 666,60 mGy*cm. 
Befund:
Es liegen konventionelle Aufnahmen des Beckens und der LWS vom selben Tag zum Vergleich vor.  
LWS:
Erhaltenes Alignement. 
Frischer imponierende Deckplattenimpressionsfraktur von LWK 2. Keine Auslenkung der Hinterkante. 
Moderate degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Höhe LWK 5/SWK 1. 
Becken: 
Einliegende zementaugmentierte Duokopfprothese rechts. Material intakt und ohne Hinweis auf Lockerung oder Dislokation. Keine periprothetische Fraktur. 
Keine Fraktur des Beckengürtels oder des rechten Femurs. 
Skleroseinsel im rechten Os ilium 
Koxarthrose links.  
Nebenbefundlich: Moderate Vasosklerose. Ausgeprägte Sigmadivertikulose.  
Zusammenfassende Beurteilung: 
Frische Fraktur LWK 2 – untypisch für eine Kompressionsfraktur ist der kaum vorhandene Höhenverlust des Wirbelkörpers, DD Extensionsverletzung.
Keine Fraktur des Beckens oder der Femora.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patient mit hepatisch metastasiertem Kolonkarzinom. Z. n. Hemikolektomie links. Regredienz der Lebermetastasen? Pulmonale Filiae?  
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Aufklärung und Einwilligung: 
Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten. 
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Intravenöse Applikation von 100 ml Imeron 400 und Akquisition des Thorax/Abdomens/Beckens in venöser Kontrastmittelphase. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 720,79 mGy*cm.
Befund: 
Es liegen mehrere Voruntersuchungen zum Vergleich vor, zuletzt CT Abdomen/Becken vom 9.9.2021 
Thorax: 
Herz nicht vergrößert. Kein Perikarderguss. Kein Nachweis einer Lungenarterienembolie soweit in venöser Kontrastmittelphase beurteilbar. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten konfigurierten mediastinalen, hilären oder axillären Lymphknoten. Einzelne verkalkte Granulome, exemplarisch mit einer Größe von 2 mm pleuraständig im rechten Mittellappen oder mit einer Größe von 3 mm pleuraständig im linken Oberlappen. Keine malignitätssuspekten pulmonalen Raumforderungen, keine pneumonischen Infiltrate. Kein Pleuraerguss oder Pneumothorax. Portsystem rechtspektoral mit Spitze der V. cava superior. 
Abdomen: 
Leber weitestgehend glatt berandet und homogen kontrastiert. Die bekannten Lebermetastasen lassen sich aktuell CT-morphologisch nur vereinzelt flau abgrenzen, exemplarisch subkapsulär an der Segmentgrenze IVa/VIII mit einer Größe von 5 mm. Gallenblase zartwandig, Sludge gefüllt und ohne röntgendichte Konkremente. Keine Erweiterung der intra- oder extrahepatischen Gallenwege. Pankreas organtypisch lobuliert, kein Aufstau des Ductus pancreaticus. Milz homogen kontrastiert und nicht vergrößert. 6 mm messende mediale Nebenmilz. Nebennieren beidseits zart. Nieren orthotop gelegen und seitengleich kontrastiert. Kleines Konkrement in der mittleren Kelchgruppe der rechten Niere. Kein Aufstau der harnableitenden Wege. Harnblase flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne fokale Wandverdickung. Z. n. Hemikolektomie links mit reizlos imponierender Anastomose im kleinen Becken. Keine pathologisch distendierten Dünn- oder Dickdarmschlingen. Keine freie Luft oder Flüssigkeit. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten oder konfigurierten mesenterialen, retroperitonealen, iliakalen oder inguinalen Lymphknoten. Durchgehende Kontrastierung der großen abdominellen Gefäße. 
Skelettsystem: 
Keine malignitätssuspekten ossären Läsionen. Moderate degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderungen mit mehrsegmentaler Spondylophytenbildung. Keine frischen Frakturen. Leichte Ankylose des rechten Sakroiliakalgelenks. 
Beurteilung: 
CT-morphologisch lassen sich die bekannten Lebermetastasen nur noch vereinzelt flau abgrenzen. 
Keine Lymphknotenmetastasen. 
Keine neuen Fernmetastasen.

Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with hepatic metastases from colon cancer. Status post left hemicolectomy. Regression of liver metastases? Pulmonary metastases?The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Information and Consent:After obtaining a risk history, the patient was verbally and in writing informed about the contrast agent application, the examination procedure, and potential risks (also refer to the consent form). Written consent was obtained from the patient.
Examination Technique:Digital overview radiographs. Intravenous administration of 100 ml Imeron 400 and acquisition of the thorax/abdomen/pelvis in the venous contrast phase. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product 720.79 mGy*cm.
Findings:Several previous examinations are available for comparison, most recently a CT of the abdomen/pelvis from 9.9.2021
Thorax:Heart not enlarged. No pericardial effusion. No evidence of pulmonary artery embolism as far as can be assessed in the venous contrast phase. No pathologically enlarged or abnormally configured mediastinal, hilar, or axillary lymph nodes. A few calcified granulomas, e.g., 2 mm attached to the pleura in the right middle lobe or 3 mm attached to the pleura in the left upper lobe. No pulmonary masses suspected of malignancy, no pneumonic infiltrates. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax. Port system in the right pectoral region with the tip in the superior vena cava.
Abdomen:Liver margins largely smooth and homogeneously contrasted. The known liver metastases are currently only faintly delineated on CT, for example, subcapsularly at the segment border IVa/VIII, measuring 5 mm. Gallbladder with thin walls, filled with sludge, and without radiopaque calculi. No dilation of the intra- or extrahepatic bile ducts. Pancreas typically lobulated, no obstruction of the pancreatic duct. Spleen homogeneously contrasted and not enlarged. Accessory spleen measuring 6 mm medially. Adrenal glands are slim on both sides. Kidneys in orthotopic positions with symmetrical contrast enhancement. Small calculus in the middle calyx group of the right kidney. No obstruction of the urinary tracts. Bladder fluid-filled and without focal wall thickening. Status post left hemicolectomy with unremarkable anastomosis in the small pelvis. No pathologically distended small or large bowel loops. No free air or fluid. No pathologically enlarged or abnormally configured mesenteric, retroperitoneal, iliac, or inguinal lymph nodes. Continuous contrast enhancement of the major abdominal vessels.
Skeletal System:No osseous lesions suspected of malignancy. Moderate degenerative changes in the spine with multisegmental formation of osteophytes. No recent fractures. Mild ankylosis of the right sacroiliac joint.
Conclusion:CT morphology shows that the known liver metastases are now only faintly delineated.No lymph node metastases.
No new distant metastases.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patient mit Schwellung im Halsbereich und Schluckbeschwerden. Frage nach Peritonsillarabszess / Parapharyngealabszess. 
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Aufklärung und Einwilligung: 
Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten.
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Intravenöse Applikation von insgesamt 75 ml Imeron 400 in Split-Bolus-Technik und Akquisition des Halses in biphasischer Kontrastmittelphase. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 310,20 mGy*cm.  
Befund: 
Es liegen keine entsprechenden Voraufnahmen zum Vergleich vor.  
Schleimhautschwellung im linken Sinus maxillaris und geringer auch im rechten Sinus maxillaris, übrige miterfasste Nasennebenhöhlen und Mastoidzellen frei belüftet. Hypodense Läsionen mit randständiger Kontrastmittelaufnahme im Bereich der Tonsillenloge beidseits ohne Ausdehnung in den jeweiligen Parapharyngealraum und einer Größe von etwa 22 x 20 x 46 mm rechts und 22 x 15 x 50 mm links. Darunter deutliche Einengung des distalen Nasoharynx/proximalen Oropharynx. Weitestgehend symmetrische Darstellung vom Hypopharynx. Larynxskelett und Epiglottis zart. Seitengleiche Kontrastierung der großen Speicheldrüsen und der Schilddrüse. Zahlreiche deutlich vergrößerte Lymphknoten, exemplarisch rechts in Level IIa mit einer Größe von 21 x 18 mm oder links in Level IIb mit einer Größe von 17 x 12 mm. Regelrechte Kontrastierung der großen zervikalen Gefäße. Kein Nachweis pneumonischer Infiltrate miterfassten apikalen Lungenabschnitten. Beginnende degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderungen.  
Beurteilung: 
Große beidseitige intra-/peritonsilläre Abszesse. Der Para- und Retropharyngealraum ist jeweils nicht betroffen. 
Am ehesten reaktiv bedingte ausgeprägte zervikale Lymphadenopathie.
translation:
English Translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:
Patient with swelling in the neck area and difficulty swallowing. Question regarding peritonsillar abscess/parapharyngeal abscess.
The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Information and Consent:After obtaining a risk history, the patient was verbally and in writing informed about the contrast agent application, the examination procedure, and potential risks (also refer to the consent form). Written consent was obtained from the patient.
Examination Technique:
Digital overview radiographs. Intravenous administration of a total of 75 ml Imeron 400 using split-bolus technique and acquisition of the neck in a biphasic contrast phase. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product: 310.20 mGy*cm.
Findings:
No relevant previous images are available for comparison.
Mucosal swelling in the left maxillary sinus and, to a lesser extent, in the right maxillary sinus; the remaining included paranasal sinuses and mastoid cells are well aerated. report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patientin mit unklaren epigastrischen Schmerzen, krampfartig, stechend, nahrungsunabhängig, ÖGD und Labor ohne wegweisenden Befund.  Schmerzkorrelat? 
Befund: Es liegen keine entsprechenden Voruntersuchungen zum Vergleich vor.
Leber: Zu ca. 90% einsehbar. Organ normal groß (14 cm in Medioclavicularlinie, MCL). Lobus caudatus grenzwertig groß (6 x 2 cm). Randwinkel spitz, Oberfläche glatt. Homogenes echonormales Parenchym. Keine fokalen Läsionen im einsehbaren Bereich abgrenzbar. Gefäßmuster normal. Einsehbare Lebervenen durchflossen. V. portae normal weit und mit antegradem Fluss (Vmax: 20 cm/s).  
Gallenblase: Gallenblase nicht vergrößert, echofreies Binnenecho. Wand normal dick ohne Hinweis auf Entzündung.  
Gallengänge: Intrahepatische Gallenwege nicht erweitert. DHC extrahepatisch im einsehbaren Bereich normal weit (3 mm).  
Pankreas: Soweit einsehbar normal groß und mit unauffälligem Parenchym. D. pancreaticus im einsehbaren Bereich nicht erweitert.  
Milz: Milz normal groß (11 x 5 cm) und normal geformt. Homogenes Parenchym. Milzvene durchflossen.  
Nieren und ableitende Harnwege: Nieren normal groß und mit altersentsprechendem Parenchym/Pyelon-Verhältnis. Keine Erweiterung des NBKS. 1,5 cm messende kortikale Nierenzyste links. Keine solide Raumforderung abzugrenzen. Harnblase mäßig, echofrei gefüllt.  
Gastrointestinaltrakt: Kein Nachweis wandverdickter oder dilatierter Darmschlingen im einsehbaren Bereich.  
Retroperitoneum: Soweit einsehbar kein Nachweis von vergrößerten Lymphknoten. Deutliche Aortensklerose.  
Freie Flüssigkeiten: Kein Aszites, keine Pleuraergüsse.  
Beurteilung: Deutliche Aortensklerose. Ggf. weiterführende Diagnostik mittels CT-Angiographie zum Ausschluss relevanter abdomineller arterieller Gefäßstenosen als Ursache der Beschwerden erwägen.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with unclear epigastric pain, cramping, stabbing, and unrelated to food intake; esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) and laboratory tests showed no conclusive findings. Pain correlation?
Findings: No relevant previous examinations are available for comparison.
Liver: Approximately 90% visible. Organ is of normal size (14 cm in the midclavicular line, MCL). Caudate lobe is borderline enlarged (6 x 2 cm). Sharp edge angles, smooth surface. Homogeneous, echonormal parenchyma. No focal lesions detectable in the visible area. Normal vascular pattern. Visible hepatic veins are patent. Portal vein is of normal wiRXh with antegrade flow (Vmax: 20 cm/s).
Gallbladder: Gallbladder is not enlarged, anechoic internal echo. Wall is of normal thickness with no signs of inflammation.
Bile Ducts: Intrahepatic bile ducts are not dilated. The extrahepatic common bile duct (CBD) in the visible area is of normal wiRXh (3 mm).
Pancreas: Normal size and unremarkable parenchyma as far as visible. The pancreatic duct in the visible area is not dilated.
Spleen: Spleen is of normal size (11 x 5 cm) and shape. Homogeneous parenchyma. Splenic vein is patent.
Kidneys and Urinary Tract: Kidneys are normal in size with an age-appropriate parenchyma/pelvis ratio. No dilation of the renal collecting system. 1.5 cm cortical renal cyst on the left side. No solid mass detectable. Urinary bladder is moderately filled and anechoic.
Gastrointestinal Tract: No evidence of thickened or dilated bowel loops in the visible area.
Retroperitoneum: No enlarged lymph nodes detectable as far as visible. Significant aortic sclerosis.
Free Fluids: No ascites, no pleural effusions.
Conclusion: Significant aortic sclerosis. Consider further diagnostics with CT angiography to rule out significant abdominal arterial vessel stenoses as the cause of the symptoms.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patientin mit zentraler Lungenarterienembolie. Frage nach tiefer Beinvenenthrombose (TVT).  
Befund: 
Es liegen keine entsprechenden Voruntersuchungen zum Vergleich vor.
Untersucht wurden beidseits die V. femoralis communis, V. femoralis superficialis, die Einmündung der V. profunda femoris, die V. poplitea, die Vv. tibia tibiales anterior und posterior, die Vv. fibulares sowie die Einmündung der V. saphena magna sowie die V. poplitea.
Atemmodulierter Fluss in der distalen V. femoralis communis. Linksseitig vollständige Komprimierbarkeit der V. femoralis communis sowie beidseits der V. femoralis superficialis, der Einmündung der V. femoralis profunda, der Einmündung der V. saphena magna und der V. poplitea. Regelrechte Flusssignale in den Vv. tibiales anteriores et posteriores sowie der Vv fibulares, mit ebenfalls erhaltener vollständiger Komprimierbarkeit des Gefäßlumens.  
Die rechtsseitige V. femoralis communis stellt sich über eine Strecke von mindestens 3,5 cm bei echoarmem Material intraluminal nicht vollständig komprimierbar dar. Hier randständig Fluss in der Dopplersonographie darstellbar. Das proximale Ende des Thrombus ist sonographisch nicht darstellbar.  
Beurteilung: Randständig umspülte Thrombose der rechtsseitigen V. femoralis communis. Das proximale Ende der Thrombose ist sonographisch nicht darstellbar. Linksseitig kein Nachweis einer okklusiven Beckenvenenthrombose oder tiefen Beinvenenthrombose.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with central pulmonary artery embolism. Question regarding deep vein thrombosis (DVT) of the legs.
Findings:No relevant previous examinations are available for comparison.
The following veins were examined bilaterally: the common femoral vein, the superficial femoral vein, the junction of the deep femoral vein, the popliteal vein, the anterior and posterior tibial veins, the fibular veins, as well as the junction of the great saphenous vein and the popliteal vein.
Respiratory-modulated flow was observed in the distal common femoral vein. On the left side, there is complete compressibility of the common femoral vein, as well as bilaterally in the superficial femoral vein, the junction of the deep femoral vein, the junction of the great saphenous vein, and the popliteal vein. Normal flow signals in the anterior and posterior tibial veins as well as the fibular veins, with also preserved complete compressibility of the vessel lumen.
The right common femoral vein is not fully compressible over a length of at least 3.5 cm due to hypoechoic intraluminal material. There is peripheral flow visible in Doppler sonography. The proximal end of the thrombus is not visible on ultrasound.
Assessment:Peripheral-flow thrombosis of the right common femoral vein. The proximal end of the thrombosis is not visible on ultrasound. No evidence of an occlusive pelvic vein thrombosis or deep vein thrombosis on the left side.

report:
Klinik, Fragestellung, Rechtfertigende Indikation: 
Patient mit sonographisch diagnostiziertem Bauchaortenaneurysma. Bildgebung im Rahmen der OP-Planung erbeten.  
Die rechtfertigende Indikation für die Anwendung ionisierender Strahlung wurde durch die zuständige fachkundige Ärztin / den zuständigen fachkundigen Arzt gestellt. 
Aufklärung und Einwilligung: 
Nach Erhebung der Risikoanamnese mündliche und schriftliche Aufklärung über die Kontrastmittelapplikation und den Untersuchungsablauf sowie mögliche Risiken der Untersuchung (vergleiche auch Aufklärungsbeleg). Schriftliche Einwilligung des Patienten.  
Untersuchungstechnik: 
Digitale Übersichtsradiographien. Intravenöse Applikation von 100 ml Imeron 400 und Akquisition des Thorax/Abdomens/Beckens in arterieller Kontrastmittelphase. Multiplanare Rekonstruktionen. Dosis-Längen-Produkt 980,59 mGy*cm.  
Befund: 
Es liegen keine entsprechenden Voruntersuchungen zum Vergleich vor.  
Gefäßsystem: 
Randständig gering thrombosiertes Aneurysma der infrarenalen Aorta mit einem maximalen Durchmesser von 50 mm. Durchgehende Kontrastierung der supraaortalen Gefäße. Geringe Abgangsstenosierung des Truncus coeliacus. Durchgehende Kontrastierung der Aa. mesenterica superior und inferior sowie der Nierenarterien. Der Abgang der A. mesenterica inferior dabei unmittelbar oberhalb des Aneurysmas. Moderate atherosklerotische Wandveränderungen der Aorta und Iliakalarterien mit hartem und weichem Plaquebesatz ohne Nachweis einer höhergradigen Stenosierung.  
Thorax: 
Herz nicht vergrößert. Kein Perikarderguss. Kein Nachweis einer Lungenarterienembolie bis auf Segmentebene. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten konfigurierten Stenosen hilären oder axillären Lymphknoten. Trachea und große Bronchien frei. 2 mm messendes verkalktes Granulom im peripheren rechten Oberlappen. Keine malignitätssuspekten pulmonalen Raumforderungen, keine pneumonischen Infiltrate. Geringe Verkalkungen der Pleura beidseits. Kein Pleuraerguss oder Pneumothorax.  
Abdomen: 
Leber mit in arterieller Kontrastmittelphase hyperdenser subkapsulärer Läsion in Segment II mit einer Größe von 15 x 13 mm DD Hämangiom. Gallenblase zartwandig, flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne röntgendichte Konkremente. Keine Erweiterung der intra- oder extrahepatischen Gallenwege. Pankreas organtypisch lobuliert, kein Aufstau des Ductus pancreaticus. Milz nicht vergrößert. Nebennieren beidseits leicht verplumpt. Nieren orthotop gelegen und seitengleich kontrastiert. Kein Aufstau der harnableitenden Wege. Harnblase flüssigkeitsgefüllt und ohne fokale Wandverdickung. Keine pathologisch distendierten Dünn- oder Dickdarmschlingen. Einzelne Sigmadivertikel. Keine freie intraabdominelle Luft oder Flüssigkeit. Keine pathologisch vergrößerten oder konfigurierten mesenterialen, retroperitonealen, iliakalen oder inguinalen Lymphknoten.  
Skelettsystem: 
Keine malignitätssuspekten ossären Läsionen. Moderate degenerative Wirbelsäulenveränderungen mitmehrsegmentaler Osteochondrosis intervertebralis. Keine frischen Frakturen. Arthrose des AC-Gelenke und Hüftgelenke beidseits.  
Beurteilung: 
Bis 50 mm messendes randständig gering thrombosiertes Aneurysma der infrarenalen Aorta. Durchgehende Kontrastierung der Viszeralarterien.
translation:
Clinic, Question, Justifying Indication:Patient with a sonographically diagnosed abdominal aortic aneurysm. Imaging requested as part of surgical planning.The justifying indication for the use of ionizing radiation was provided by the responsible, qualified physician.
Information and Consent:After obtaining a risk history, the patient was verbally and in writing informed about the contrast agent application, the examination procedure, and potential risks (also refer to the consent form). Written consent was obtained from the patient.
Examination Technique:Digital overview radiographs. Intravenous application of 100 ml Imeron 400 and acquisition of the thorax/abdomen/pelvis in the arterial contrast phase. Multiplanar reconstructions. Dose-length product 980.59 mGy*cm.
Findings:No relevant previous examinations are available for comparison.
Vascular System:Marginally thrombotic aneurysm of the infrarenal aorta with a maximum diameter of 50 mm. Continuous contrast of the supraaortic vessels. Mild ostial stenosis of the celiac trunk. Continuous contrast of the superior and inferior mesenteric arteries as well as the renal arteries. The inferior mesenteric artery originates immediately above the aneurysm. Moderate atherosclerotic wall changes of the aorta and iliac arteries with hard and soft plaque deposits, without evidence of high-grade stenosis.
Thorax:Heart not enlarged. No pericardial effusion. No evidence of pulmonary embolism up to the segmental level. No pathologically enlarged or configured hilar or axillary lymph nodes. Trachea and large bronchi clear. Calcified granuloma measuring 2 mm in the peripheral right upper lobe. No suspicious pulmonary masses indicative of malignancy, no pneumonic infiltrates. Mild pleural calcifications on both sides. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax.
Abdomen:Liver with a hyperdense subcapsular lesion in the arterial contrast phase in segment II measuring 15 x 13 mm DD hemangioma. Gallbladder thin-walled, fluid-filled, and without radiopaque stones. No dilation of intra- or extrahepatic bile ducts. Pancreas with typical lobulated appearance, no dilatation of the pancreatic duct. Spleen not enlarged. Adrenal glands slightly plump bilaterally. Kidneys in orthotopic position with symmetrical contrast enhancement. No dilation of the urinary tract. Bladder fluid-filled without focal wall thickening. No pathologically distended small or large bowel loops. Few sigmoid diverticula. No free intra-abdominal air or fluid. No pathologically enlarged or configured mesenteric, retroperitoneal, iliac, or inguinal lymph nodes.
Skeletal System:No suspicious osseous lesions indicative of malignancy. Moderate degenerative changes in the spine with multisegmental osteochondrosis intervertebralis. No fresh fractures. Arthrosis of the acromioclavicular (AC) joints and hip joints bilaterally.
Conclusion:Marginally thrombotic aneurysm of the infrarenal aorta measuring up to 50 mm. Continuous contrast enhancement of the visceral arteries.
